description:
Whether it's lactic acid-drenched laps between the tape or flat-out cross-country adventures, this bike has you covered. A lightweight carbon frame, 120/100 mm travel split plus high-performance kit from SRAM and RockShox.

Whether you're a racer or you just love big cross-country days at maximum attack, the NINETY-SIX 6000 is a lightweight but highly capable platform for your adventures. With a full carbon fibre frame that uses our P-FLEX flexstay technology to tame the bumps without any excess weight, it's light enough for lactic acid-drenched laps between the tape but capable enough on the trail thanks to a 120 mm RockShox fork. Add in the precise shifting under load of the latest SRAM Eagle 70 with direct-mount derailleur and the power of SRAM's DB8 stealth brakes and you're good to go.

The NINETY-SIX is the latest incarnation of our former World Cup proven XC and marathon machine. It inherits the forward-surging race genes of the old NINETY-SIX and combines it with a new readiness and ability to tackle today’s demanding XC and marathon courses. The carbon fibre frame platform and P-FLEX suspension is the perfect basis for a fun-packed, fast and trail loving short travel full suspension machine that helps define what a modern cross-country race bike should be. It's able to take on the rougher than ever world-class race tracks as well as the trail riders who want hyper-speed climbing with the ability to descend like never before.
